connectedEditor.ownershipBoundary: Definitions mutations, graph mutations and process selectors share the strict existing single-process/single-plane resolver; no owner creation or first-process fallback on read
connectedEditor.referenceSelectionBoundary: Event/activity/data/operation consumers use retained scoped identity resolution/encoding; display-name edits preserve payload type and escalation code. Builtin type creation uses expanded XML Schema names; type/call drafts use the existing pending-edit owner, and mapping rows retain explicit selection intent without persisting DTO tokens. Full standard families stay unadvertised until their end-to-end contracts pass.
connectedEditor.laneBoundary: Retain recursive lane creation/projection/properties and actual owner-tree reparenting; preserve valid ancestor IDREF memberships, carry inherited namespace scopes in clipboard subtrees and remove subtree DI without deleting process tasks. Canvas/SVG honor shape orientation; native Splitter collapse changes only the viewport. Remaining standard families stay staged.
connectedEditor.taskBoundary: Extend the retained TaskNode/TaskNodeSvg, palette, creation and morph chain to all eight standard process task kinds. Morph only schema-illegal fields; preserve compatible implementation, I/O, resource/loop data, references, namespaces and DI without mapping reconciliation or shared-definition deletion. Compose existing Facade task properties for standard fields and real resource roles; preserve valid I/O display names with spaces.
connectedEditor.globalTaskBoundary: Five definitions-level global task kinds stay outside node/palette/DI maps. Extend the retained CalledElementSelector/CallActivityProperties directly with Facade choices, modals and legal fields. The shared scoped index owns identity/reference repair and fail-closed deletion, including child consumers; explicit raw references remain distinct from selection IDs. Global I/O preserves sets/bindings, scripts use scriptLanguage, rendering extensions survive documentation edits. Call nodes borrow the resolved task marker from their current definitions snapshot in canvas and SVG; collapsed fields retain pending drafts through native display-none retention. Other unfinished families remain staged.
connectedEditor.activityBoundary: Retained activity properties expose standard, parallel and sequential loop semantics plus compensation without rebuilding I/O. Ordinary/ad-hoc/event/transaction subprocesses share recursive owner/lane projection and lossless expanded/collapsed DI. Fields preserve expression metadata/default absence; schema-intersection and explicit event-mode morphs retain compatible data and reject referenced removals. Pure context guards share source/morph/containment rules. Retained clipboard/delete own complete hidden descendants and boundaries in history transactions. Deepest visible containment wins; rejected gestures restore model and selection identities. Native Facade controls and the shared in-canvas Alert add no stylesheet. Full activity-family acceptance remains with the Phase 3 review.
connectedEditor.eventBoundary: Retained event nodes/morphs/properties use concrete definition arrays, eventDefinitionRef and parallelMultiple. Source, canvas, property headers and standalone SVG share resolved notation. Native trigger controls preserve repeated definitions, expression metadata and shared-root identity; copied inline declarations remap only their owned subtree. Attachment/detachment retains event XML and semantic scope. QName host clipboard closure, actual-DI containment and centered border snapping replace raw-reference/minimum-size assumptions. Event-subprocess/transaction Cancel contexts share that chain; full family acceptance remains with the Phase 3 review.
connectedEditor.eventSubProcessBoundary: Retained event-subprocess properties compose shared expansion/variables without prohibited loop controls. Standard triggeredByEvent mode requires one triggered start and no external flows; explicit morphs retain compatible XML/DI and guard removed trigger consumers. Collapsed canvas/SVG derive the actual start marker and interruption. Native RF onBeforeDelete commits selected semantic groups atomically so required-start rejection cannot strand connected-edge removals.
connectedEditor.status: Integrated XML-backed Page/editor with bounded initial source profile; mandatory standard families and full release acceptance remain open
